notes: A used airframe now starts with less worn parts: no part begins more than 80 % through its life (70 % for tyres and brakes), spread by the aircraft's age, so a fault comes from flying it. Airframes you already have are not changed.

The saved cockpit now includes the EVAC "CAPT & PURS / CAPT" selector (its own EVAC panel on the Cockpit page), A/SKID & N/W STRG, the transponder ATC SYS selector and the two chart-light toggles: 257 switches in 25 panels.
Every switch name the cockpit list already had exists in Fenix V3, so nothing was renamed. Not seen yet: the new switches read and restored against a running V3.
